notes: d (narrative, no figure): DDB applies its constant rate (2/5 = 40%) to the declining carrying amount rather than to depreciable cost, so residual value never enters the rate calculation; the method still lands exactly on residual because the residual-value floor forces the final year's expense to be a plug - in Year 5 the computed 2592.00 is replaced by 1480.00, the amount needed to bring carrying amount down to the $5,000 residual and no further. Part c disposal: proceeds $12,000 less carrying amount at 12/31/Year 3 of $10800.00 = a GAIN of $1200.00.
